summary: **AI Engineer** building agentic LLM systems, memory, and RAG — **16 merged PRs** into Mastra's agent runtime (**27k+ stars**), shipped production agents at AiRA, and scaled a campus platform to **10,000+ users**.

experience.role: AI Engineer (Agent Orchestration, Memory, RAG & Systems)

bullets.text: Built the flagship **Daily Brief** agent (**Python**/**FastAPI**) — an **agentic orchestration loop** coordinating Email, Calendar, and **Exa AI** web-search tools via **asyncio** into each user's personalized morning briefing.

Architected a multi-tier **memory system** (working / medium / long-term) on **MongoDB** and **Redis** that distills each user's conversations and style into a preferences store for personalization and proactive check-ins.

Cut routing-**LLM** token usage by **82%** via artifact-based prompting and context deduplication, and stood up **promptfoo** evals across 8+ models with **Langfuse** traces to standardize model selection, latency, and cost.

Developed **CircuitSynth**, fine-tuning **Qwen models (4B/8B)** with **LoRA/QLoRA** and a multi-stage **RAG** pipeline to generate executable Arduino circuit JSONs at **75% accuracy**, quantized to **GGUF** for **Raspberry Pi**.
Built **Samagra**, a campus ERP platform grown to **10,000+ active users** — a **React Native** mobile client, a **Node.js**/**Express** **REST API**, **MongoDB**, and a **Next.js** web app.

Engineered **JWT authentication** with **role-based access control** and **Socket.io** real-time sync, and owned **CI/CD** and release on a **zero-cost** Vercel backend serving **150k+ monthly API requests**.
Delivered 6 commercial **MERN** web applications, cutting client cost **30%** and time-to-market **45%**.
Designed **REST APIs** and **MongoDB** schemas serving **50,000+ monthly requests** at **99.9% uptime**.

**18 merged PRs** upstream — **16 into mastra-ai/mastra (27k+ stars)** [[PR list]](https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra/pulls?q=author:Sandy-1711) across the core agent runtime, streaming, ai-sdk, and Studio: ordering interleaved text and tool calls mid-stream and preserving persisted assistant messages on **tool-approval** resume. Contributing since June 2026.

**cal.com (47k+ stars)**: Authored a full **BigBlueButton video integration** — checksum-signed client, encrypted credential storage, **912 LOC** on a bounty issue. **n8n (202k stars)**: Webhook CSP security fix (`allow-same-origin`).

One **TypeScript** interface for **text-to-speech** and **speech-to-text** across **Cartesia**, **Deepgram**, and **ElevenLabs** — switching providers takes a one-line change, and capability declarations surface unsupported features up front.
